courses.name: Beginner Yoga Foundation
courses.shortDescription: Gentle introduction to foundational asanas, breathing techniques, and posture alignment.
courses.description: Start your transformative yoga journey with our Beginner Yoga Foundation course. Designed specifically for individuals new to yoga or those looking to rebuild their foundation, this course covers fundamental postures (asanas), basic breathing exercises (pranayama), and simple relaxation techniques. You will build strength, improve flexibility, and learn how to practice safely with modifications tailored to your body.
benefits: Improve baseline spinal flexibility & joint mobility
Master correct breathing mechanics & posture alignment
Relieve daily back tension and mental fatigue
Step-by-step guidance suitable for absolute beginners
requirements: Comfortable stretchy clothing and a yoga mat
Open mind and willingness to practice with patience
curriculum: Week 1: Fundamentals of Alignment & Sun Salutations (Surya Namaskar)
Week 2: Standing & Balancing Postures for Core Strength
Week 3: Seated & Gentle Twisting Asanas for Spine Health
Week 4: Basic Pranayama (Nadi Shodhana) & Guided Yoga Nidra
courses.title: Beginner Yoga Foundation

courses.name: Advanced Hatha & Vinyasa Flow
courses.shortDescription: Dynamic, breath-synchronized sequence for strength, endurance, arm balances, and deep focus.
courses.description: Take your practice to higher realms with our Advanced Hatha & Vinyasa Flow. This immersive course blends traditional Hatha holds with fluid Vinyasa transitions, challenging inversions, deep hip openers, and intense pranayama. Ideal for intermediate to advanced practitioners seeking to deepen their mind-body connection and master intricate asanas.
benefits: Master advanced arm balances, handstands, and inversions
Enhance muscular endurance and core stability
Cultivate internal heat and deep detoxification
Refine advanced bandhas and ujjayi pranayama control
requirements: At least 6 months of consistent yoga practice
Ability to comfortably perform basic Surya Namaskar cycles
curriculum: Module 1: Dynamic Flow Transitions & Core Integration
Module 2: Inversion Lab (Pincha, Handstand & Headstand fundamentals)
Module 3: Deep Backbends & Heart-Opening Asanas
Module 4: Advanced Pranayama (Kapalabhati, Bhastrika) & Dhyana
courses.title: Advanced Hatha & Vinyasa Flow

courses.name: Weight Management & Core Power Yoga
courses.shortDescription: High-energy metabolic yoga workout to burn calories, tone muscles, and boost vitality.
courses.description: Sculpt your body and elevate your metabolism with Power Yoga for Weight Management. This program integrates rapid sun salutations, warrior sequences, core-strengthening drills, and metabolic conditioning with mindful breathwork. It helps burn visceral fat, build lean muscle mass, stimulate thyroid function, and enhance digestion.
benefits: Boost metabolic rate and support sustainable weight loss
Tone abdominal, gluteal, and back musculature
Enhance cardiovascular endurance without joint stress
Includes personalized dietary and Ayurvedic lifestyle tips
requirements: Suitable for beginners to intermediate fitness levels
Doctor clearance if you have recent surgeries or acute back injury
curriculum: Phase 1: Metabolic Activation & Navasana Drills
Phase 2: Warrior Series & Lower Body Sculpting
Phase 3: Core Compression & Side-Plank Complexes
Phase 4: High-Burn Vinyasa Ladders & Cool-Down Stretches
courses.title: Weight Management & Core Power Yoga

courses.name: Pranayama & Mindful Meditation
courses.shortDescription: Sacred breathwork and meditation techniques to silence mental noise and expand consciousness.
courses.description: Dive deep into the ancient science of Prana (life-force energy). This meditative course systematically unlocks the healing power of breath through traditional pranayama techniques and dhyana (meditation). You will cultivate profound stillness, balance the autonomic nervous system, regulate blood pressure, and awaken mental clarity.
benefits: Calm an overactive nervous system and reduce anxiety
Increase lung capacity and oxygenation of brain cells
Enhance emotional stability, focus, and memory retention
Master mindfulness, mantra chanting, and Chakra meditation
requirements: Open to all ages and experience levels
A quiet space and meditation cushion/chair
curriculum: Week 1: Diaphragmatic Breath & Nadi Shodhana (Alternate Nostril)
Week 2: Cooling & Heating Pranayamas (Sheetali, Sheetkari, Bhastrika)
Week 3: Bhramari, Omkar Chanting, & Silent Vipassana Meditation
courses.title: Pranayama & Mindful Meditation

courses.name: Stress Relief & Restorative Yoga
courses.shortDescription: Passive, supported poses to calm the nervous system, release anxiety, and restore vitality.
courses.description: In an era of relentless hustle and digital overload, Restorative Yoga offers a sacred sanctuary for deep healing. Supported by bolsters, blankets, and blocks, you will hold gentle postures for 5 to 10 minutes without physical exertion. This allows the parasympathetic nervous system to take over, soothing adrenal glands, releasing chronic tension, and cultivating emotional peace.
benefits: Lower cortisol levels and soothe chronic fatigue
Deeply relax tight fascia, neck, shoulders, and hips
Alleviate insomnia and promote deep, restorative sleep
Experience therapeutic sound bath and guided visualizations
requirements: Props recommended: pillows, blanket, yoga mat
curriculum: Session 1-4: Releasing Tension in Upper Back & Trapezius
Session 5-8: Hip Opening & Emotional Release through Yin holds
Session 9-12: Full Body Restoration & 30-min Yoga Nidra
courses.title: Stress Relief & Restorative Yoga

courses.name: Flexibility & Mobility Immersion
courses.shortDescription: Targeted myofascial release and joint opening for full-body freedom and injury prevention.
courses.description: Unlock tight hamstrings, rigid hips, stiff shoulders, and inflexible spines. This mobility immersion bridges active yoga postures with functional biomechanics to increase your functional range of motion safely. Whether you are a runner, desk worker, or yoga enthusiast, you will notice extraordinary freedom in movement.
benefits: Eliminate joint stiffness and expand range of motion
Lengthen shortened hamstrings, hip flexors, and calf muscles
Improve athletic performance and prevent musculoskeletal injuries
Learn PNF (Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation) stretching
requirements: Yoga strap and two yoga blocks recommended
curriculum: Week 1: Pelvic Floor, Hamstring & Glute Mobility
Week 2: Thoracic Spine & Shoulder Girdle Liberation
Week 3: Hip Joint Opening (Hanumanasana & Pigeon prep)
Week 4: Full Kinetic Chain Integration & Balance
courses.title: Flexibility & Mobility Immersion

courses.name: 1-on-1 Personal Yoga Training
courses.shortDescription: Tailored private mentorship designed exclusively around your physical goals, health conditions & schedule.
courses.description: Receive 100% personalized attention from master yogacharyas. Whether recovering from an injury, managing diabetes or thyroid, preparing for pregnancy, or targeting specific advanced asanas, our private coaching offers customized postures, individualized breathing protocols, and ongoing lifestyle mentorship.
benefits: 100% individualized routine tailored to your health needs
Direct real-time postural alignment & corrections
Flexible session timings that fit your busy calendar
Includes private nutrition & Ayurvedic wellness consultation
requirements: Initial 15-minute consultation to assess goals and physical profile
High speed internet if taking online sessions or visit studio
curriculum: Week 1: Diagnostic Assessment & Custom Asana Blueprint
Week 2-3: Progressive Functional Strength & Alignment Drills
Week 4: Personalized Pranayama & Self-Practice Protocol
courses.title: 1-on-1 Personal Yoga Training

instructors.name: Acharya Ananya Sharma
instructors.specialization: Classical Hatha, Yoga Therapy & Therapeutic Pranayama
instructors.bio: With over 14 years of teaching across India and internationally, Acharya Ananya inspires students with a warm, authentic, and deeply grounded approach to yoga. Her classes combine traditional Vedic philosophy with practical biomechanics.

instructors.name: Yogacharya Rohan Verma
instructors.specialization: Dynamic Vinyasa Flow, Arm Balances & Mobility Biomechanics
instructors.bio: Rohan brings infectious energy and laser precision to alignment. He has coached over 5,000 students worldwide to overcome fears of inversions and cultivate unwavering core strength.

instructors.name: Priya Nair
instructors.specialization: Weight Management, Core Power & Women's Health
instructors.bio: Priya empowers students to transform their metabolism, tone their bodies, and discover joyful movement. Her dynamic, music-infused sessions inspire daily consistency and energy.

instructors.name: Meera Krishnan
instructors.specialization: Restorative Yoga, Sound Bath & Yoga Nidra
instructors.bio: Meera crafts transformative somatic experiences where singing bowls, guided meditation, and deeply restorative postures help dissolve years of stress and emotional tension.

testimonials.name: Dr. Rajesh Kulkarni
testimonials.comment: Joining PranaVeda transformed my posture and relieved my chronic lower back stiffness within just 4 weeks. The instructors teach with scientific precision and genuine care.

testimonials.name: Sneha Mukherjee
testimonials.comment: As someone working long hours on screens, the Pranayama and Evening Restorative classes are my daily reset button. I sleep deeper, feel calmer, and my focus has skyrocketed.

testimonials.name: Vikram Malhotra
testimonials.comment: The Power Yoga and 1-on-1 coaching helped me lose 8 kg while building real flexibility. The admin portal, automated payment receipts, and WhatsApp reminders make everything frictionless!
